(3) A man with long brown hair wearing a green t-shirt is seated at a wooden table. A woman wearing a black t-shirt and a dark brown apron stands beside him. She holds a piece of lettuce and meticulously adds grilled meat, kimchi, and a dollop of sauce using a spoon. (4) The woman leans in and feeds the prepared lettuce wrap directly into the man's mouth.
